title: この星明かりをしるべにして

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road fails to get a spot in the Japan Cup, and the next day, she doesn't show up to class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega decides she wants to go talk with her and respectfully asks me to cancel training for the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a clumsy attempt to make the most of their skipping class, Admire Vega suggests they visit a nice spot for some stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, Narita Top Road confesses that she might have reached the end of her road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Admire Vega, who once shunned outside help, now reaches out herself, professing her desire to run against Narita Top Road for who she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two make a promise under the starry sky to compete against each other again.
